sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.

sentences.en: Today, the Republican strategy to win the midterms and how it's playing out in spending, advertising, televised candidate debates, and personal attacks.
sentences.zh: 今天，共和党赢得中期选举的战略，以及它在资金、广告、电视候选人辩论和人身攻击中的表现。

sentences.en: I spoke with three of my colleagues, political reporters Shane Goldmacher, Lisa Lair, and Nate Cohn.
sentences.zh: 我与我的三位同事、政治记者肖恩·戈德马彻、丽莎·莱尔和内特·科恩进行了交谈。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, October 15th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月15日，星期四。

sentences.en: Lisa and Shane and Nate, thank you for joining this campaign roundtable.
sentences.zh: 丽莎、肖恩和内特，谢谢你们参加这次竞选圆桌会议。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: Thanks for having us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我们。

sentences.en: Woohoo.
sentences.zh: 呜呼。

sentences.en: I appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 我很感激。

sentences.en: Woohoo, Shane.
sentences.zh: 呜呼，肖恩。

sentences.en: Big energy.
sentences.zh: 能量满满。

sentences.en: So, loyal listeners of The Daily will recall that we have spent a lot of time on the show in the past few weeks talking about Democratic momentum in these midterm elections,
sentences.zh: 所以，《每日新闻》的忠实听众会记得，在过去的几周里，我们在节目中花了很多时间讨论民主党在这次中期选举中的势头，

sentences.en: especially in traditionally red states.
sentences.zh: 特别是在传统的红州。

sentences.en: We've talked about the fact that Democrats are favored, not by a lot, but favored to win both the House and the Senate based on our own polling.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过这样一个事实：根据我们自己的民调，民主党人受到青睐，虽然优势不大，但确实有望赢得众议院和参议院。

sentences.en: But today, we want to focus on the Republican strategy for winning these midterms and the potential electoral path to a Republican victory.
sentences.zh: 但今天，我们想把重点放在共和党赢得这次中期选举的战略上，以及共和党取得胜利的潜在选举路径。

sentences.en: And so, Shane, let me start with you.
sentences.zh: 所以，肖恩，我从你开始。

sentences.en: Can you summarize, based on your reporting, what the Republican strategy for victory is?
sentences.zh: 根据你的报道，你能总结一下共和党胜利的战略是什么吗？

sentences.en: And I guess just clarify what would even constitute a Republican triumph in this election.
sentences.zh: 我想顺便澄清一下，在这场选举中，什么才算得上是共和党的胜利。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think that the Republican strategy for victory right now in the House doesn't really look like victory.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我认为目前众议院共和党的胜利战略看起来并不太像胜利。

sentences.en: It looks like keeping their losses to be in the minority, but not by a lot.
sentences.zh: 它看起来像是把损失控制在保持少数党地位，但差距不会太大。

sentences.en: This week, they made a number of changes to their ad reservations that basically seeded two more current Republican held seats after they seeded one last week.
sentences.zh: 本周，他们对广告预留做了一些调整，继上周放弃一个现有的共和党席位后，实际上又放弃了两个现有的共和党席位。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: They're seeding sufficient races to let you know that they've given up on the math of winning the House.
sentences.zh: 他们放弃的竞选足够多，让你知道他们已经放弃了赢得众议院的数学计算。

sentences.en: You don't give up on your incumbents unless things are looking bad.
sentences.zh: 除非情况看起来很糟糕，否则你不会放弃你的现任议员。

sentences.en: And people are saying this is to stave off deeper potential losses.
sentences.zh: 人们说这是为了避免更潜在的深重损失。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So in the House, victory might mean losing by less, right?
sentences.zh: 所以在众议院，胜利可能意味着输得少一点，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not actually holding the majority at this moment.
sentences.zh: 目前其实并不是守住多数席位。

sentences.en: And it's a totally different story in the Senate where Republicans very much have a chance to hold their majority.
sentences.zh: 参议院的情况则完全不同，共和党人在那里很有机会守住他们的多数席位，

sentences.en: and they're doing so by competing in a number of traditionally red states.
sentences.zh: 他们通过在许多传统红州进行竞争来实现这一点。

sentences.en: The map has gotten deeper into their territory, but it still is favoring the Republicans such that they can win if they hold states they typically win in.
sentences.zh: 版图已经深入他们的地盘，但它仍然对共和党有利，只要他们守住通常能赢下的州，他们就能获胜。

sentences.en: So the Republican strategy is to protect its majority, really, in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 所以共和党的战略实际上是保护其在参议院的多数地位。

sentences.en: And I have to imagine that a big way that it does that, we've talked about it in past episodes, is by tapping into this extraordinary financial advantage
sentences.zh: 我想它做到这一大步的方式，我们在过去的节目中讨论过，就是利用这种非凡的资金优势，

sentences.en: that the Republican Party has in these midterms over Democrats.
sentences.zh: 共和党在这次中期选举中相比民主党所拥有的优势。

sentences.en: And I wonder how it is using that money, Lisa.
sentences.zh: 我想知道它是如何使用这笔资金的，丽莎。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, part of how they're trying to circle the wagons, as Shane said, is by just dumping money into these races.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如肖恩所说，他们试图抱团取暖的部分方式，就是把资金大笔注入这些竞选。

sentences.en: Texas has seen just an extraordinary influx of Republican money, and they are just pounding the airwaves with ads,
sentences.zh: 德克萨斯州见证了共和党资金的非凡涌入，他们正在用广告狂轰滥炸，

sentences.en: largely linking Democrats to the more progressive socialist wing of their party.
sentences.zh: 主要将民主党与他们党内更激进的社会主义派别联系起来。

sentences.en: I think most of it is negative on Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中大部分是针对民主党的负面宣传。

sentences.en: There's some effort also to tout some economic improvements made by President Trump.
sentences.zh: 也有一些努力在宣传特朗普总统取得的一些经济改善。

sentences.en: But most of this is a negative campaign against Democrats and, you know, a focus also on crime and threats to personal safety.
sentences.zh: 但其中大部分是针对民主党的负面竞选，而且你知道，重点也放在犯罪和对人身安全的威胁上。

sentences.en: But yeah, the main thing Republicans have going for them here, along with the map, is the extreme financial advantage they have over Democrats.
sentences.zh: 但，是的，共和党在这里拥有的主要优势，除了选区版图，就是他们对民主党享有的极端的资金优势。

sentences.en: And it's really raised the question for Democrats of, can you beat out beat 10 to 1?
sentences.zh: 这确实给民主党提出了一个问题：你能以1比10的劣势击败对手吗？

sentences.en: And so in a race, can you beat out beat in spending 1,000 to 1?
sentences.zh: 所以在竞选中，你能以1比1,000的资金投入击败对手吗？

sentences.en: And that's something that this election will help show us the answer to.
sentences.zh: 这就是这次选举将帮助我们展示答案的问题。

sentences.en: Shane, how do you think about that?
sentences.zh: 肖恩，你是怎么看待这个问题的？

sentences.en: I just think about, you know, Lisa brought up Texas.
sentences.zh: 我只是在想，你知道，丽莎提到了德克萨斯州。

sentences.en: This is the state where you see the biggest disparity in spending so far.
sentences.zh: 这是你看到迄今为止最大支出差距的州。

sentences.en: Republicans have outspent Democrats by something like $175 million.
sentences.zh: 共和党人在支出上超过民主党大约1.75亿美元。

sentences.en: In favor of Ken Paxton, Senate Republican candidate, over James Tallarico, the Democratic Senate candidate.
sentences.zh: 这是为了支持参议院共和党候选人肯·帕克斯顿，战胜民主党参议院候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科。

sentences.en: And where has that money come from?
sentences.zh: 这些钱是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: It's come from Elon Musk.
sentences.zh: 它来自埃隆·马斯克。

sentences.en: So our colleague, Teddy Schliefer, wrote this week that Musk has contributed $276 million to the Republican Party.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的同事泰迪·施莱弗本周写道，马斯克已经向共和党捐赠了2.76亿美元。

sentences.en: This is on top of what we already knew was at least a half billion dollar Republican financial advantage.
sentences.zh: 这建立在我们已经知道的共和党至少拥有五亿美元资金优势的基础之上。

sentences.en: We are pressing towards a billion dollars more of Republican money from big super PACs and national parties than Democrats have.
sentences.zh: 我们正在向来自大型超级政治行动委员会和全国政党的、比民主党多出近十亿美元的共和党资金迈进。

sentences.en: And that is playing out nowhere more than Texas, where Musk has his business and where the super PAC he funded has spent $150, $158 million.
sentences.zh: 这一点在德克萨斯州体现得最为淋漓尽致，马斯克的业务在那里，他资助的超级政治行动委员会已经支出了1.5亿、1.58亿美元。

sentences.en: So this is one man, the world's richest man, completely changing the dynamics of a key Senate race.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个人的事，世界首富，完全改变了一个关键参议院竞选的动态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, let's ask Nate the question, is he, in fact, changing the dynamics of the Texas Senate race?
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们问问内特这个问题，他实际上是否在改变德克萨斯州参议院竞选的动态？

sentences.en: What do the polls tell us?
sentences.zh: 民调告诉了我们什么？

sentences.en: And are the polls telling us anything about whether the Republican financial advantage,
sentences.zh: 民调是否告诉我们关于共和党资金优势的任何信息，

sentences.en: as evidenced by this circling of the wagons and this onslaught in the final weeks of the race,
sentences.zh: 正如这种抱团取暖和竞选最后几周的猛烈攻势所证明的那样，

sentences.en: is really doing anything to tighten these key Senate races where Democrats have had an advantage?
sentences.zh: 是否真的在任何程度上收紧了这些民主党曾占优势的关键参议院竞选？

sentences.en: In short, the answer is no.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，答案是没有。

sentences.en: There is so far no evidence that the Republican Party's enormous financial advantage has moved the needle in their favor.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，没有证据表明共和党巨大的资金优势已经扭转了对他们有利的局面。

sentences.en: The Democrats still lead by a wide nine-point margin in the national polls.
sentences.zh: 在全国民调中，民主党仍然以9个百分点的宽幅领先。

sentences.en: The key Senate polls still show Democrats faring astonishingly well in red states, including in Texas,
sentences.zh: 关键参议院民调仍然显示民主党在红州的表现好得惊人，包括在德克萨斯州，

sentences.en: where every poll since Labor Day shows James Tallarico with a lead over Ken Paxson again in Texas.
sentences.zh: 在那里，自劳动节以来的每一次民调都显示詹姆斯·塔拉里科再次领先于肯·帕克斯顿。

sentences.en: It's worth emphasizing that there's still three weeks to go until the election.
sentences.zh: 值得强调的是，距离选举还有三周时间。

sentences.en: This is a midterm, not a presidential year.
sentences.zh: 这是一次中期选举，而不是总统大选年。

sentences.en: People are tuning in much later than usual in a midterm election.
sentences.zh: 在中期选举中，人们关注的时间比平时晚得多。

sentences.en: They don't know these candidates well.
sentences.zh: 他们对这些候选人并不十分了解。

sentences.en: So I don't think that precludes a Republican comeback.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这并不排除共和党卷土重来的可能。

sentences.en: And it's worth noting that the polls do show something really important about the Republican opportunity,
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，民调确实显示了关于共和党机会的一些非常重要的事情，

sentences.en: which is that although they are losing in all of these states or at least are faring much worse than they should be in all of these states, including Texas,
sentences.zh: 那就是尽管他们在所有这些州都处于落后，或者至少表现得比他们应该表现的要糟糕得多，包括德克萨斯州，

sentences.en: these are still Republican voters that we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的仍然是共和党选民。

sentences.en: There are more Republicans in all of these states, even now, than Democrats.
sentences.zh: 即使在现在，所有这些州里共和党人仍然比民主党人多。

sentences.en: The only thing they need to do is get their own people back on their side over the last three weeks before the election.
sentences.zh: 他们唯一需要做的是在选举前的最后三周内，把他们自己的人重新拉回到他们这一边。

sentences.en: Ordinarily, this should be easy.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，这应该很容易。

sentences.en: In the end, they may well pull it off.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们很可能会成功。

sentences.en: They definitely have the money to do it.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对有钱做到这一点。

sentences.en: But the opening on paper is still there.
sentences.zh: 但在纸面上，机会依然存在。

sentences.en: You can still tell yourself, if you're a Republican strategist, that this is still a voter that you ought to be able to get on board down the stretch.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一个共和党战略家，你仍然可以告诉自己，这仍然是一个你本应该能够在最后阶段争取到的选民。

sentences.en: Lisa, I can see you itching to jump in.
sentences.zh: 丽莎，我看得出你急不可待地想插话了。

sentences.en: Well, that's part of what I find so fascinating about these midterMs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是我发现这些中期选举如此迷人的部分原因。

sentences.en: You know, we spend a lot of time in our business talking about swing voters and independent voters and people are persuadable.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在这一行花了很多时间讨论摇摆选民、独立选民以及容易被说服的人。

sentences.en: And in some ways, those people are still important in this race.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，这些人在这次竞选中仍然很重要。

sentences.en: But in this race, it's not just about those voters.
sentences.zh: 但在这次竞选中，不仅仅关乎这些选民。

sentences.en: It's about whether Republican voters can simply, as Nate pointed out, be motivated to go cast a ballot for a Republican candidate.
sentences.zh: 这关乎共和党选民是否能如内特所指出那样，被简单地激励去为共和党候选人投票。

sentences.en: It's about whether these voters stay home and just don't show up.
sentences.zh: 这关乎这些选民是否会呆在家里干脆不出门。

sentences.en: It's always harder for Republicans to get their people out when Donald Trump is not on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 当唐纳德·特朗普不在选票上时，共和党人动员自己的人总是更难。

sentences.en: That's part of why the president has been going all over to these red states and saying, pretend I'm on the ballot.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么总统一直到处去这些红州并说，假装我在选票上。

sentences.en: But there's something else going on here,
sentences.zh: 但这里还有其他事情在发生，

sentences.en: which is that some portion of the Republican electorate is disappointed in the president and are unhappy with sort of the economic situation that people are in right now,
sentences.zh: 那就是一部分共和党选民对总统感到失望，对人们目前所处的经济状况感到不满，

sentences.en: the high fuel prices in particular, but also inflation.
sentences.zh: 特别是高昂的燃料价格，还有通货膨胀。

sentences.en: Some section of them don't like the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 他们中的一部分人不喜欢关税。

sentences.en: They don't like the war in Iran.
sentences.zh: 他们不喜欢伊朗战争。

sentences.en: And they are disappointed.
sentences.zh: 他们感到失望。

sentences.en: and they may just stay home.
sentences.zh: 他们可能只会呆在家里。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: One thing that really strikes me in the polling that we have is that in all of the red
sentences.zh: 我们在民调中发现的一个真正引人注目的事情是，在我们一直在谈论的所有红州，

sentences.en: states that we've been talking about, like Texas and you know the others, the president is really unpopular.
sentences.zh: 比如德克萨斯州和其他一些州，总统真的很不受欢迎。

sentences.en: His approval rating could be in the low 40s or the 30s in these states.
sentences.zh: 在这些州，他的支持率可能在40%出头或30%左右。

sentences.en: This is something that the president's party just hasn't had to deal with since the Bush years.
sentences.zh: 这是总统所在的政党自小布什执政以来一直没有遇到过的事情。

sentences.en: When Donald
sentences.zh: 当唐纳德·

sentences.en: Trump helped Republicans win red states in the 2018 midterm, he was popular in Texas when Ted
sentences.zh: 特朗普在2018年中期选举中帮助共和党赢得红州时，当特德·克鲁兹获胜时，他在德克萨斯州很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Cruz won.
sentences.zh: 当他们能够拉下克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔时，他在密苏里州很受欢迎。

sentences.en: He was popular in Missouri when they could bring down a Claire McCaskill.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文拆分，合并为：当他们能够拉下克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔时，他在密苏里州很受欢迎。）

sentences.en: Donald Trump is not popular in these red states today.
sentences.zh: 今天，唐纳德·特朗普在这些红州并不受欢迎。

sentences.en: And as a result, the four underneath Republican candidates is at least right now in the polls, it's not there and they are falling much farther than you
sentences.zh: 结果就是，共和党候选人在底层的表现至少目前在民调中没有体现出来，而且他们的跌幅远远超过你平时想象的那样。

sentences.en: would ordinarily think they could.
sentences.zh: （注：此处原文拆分，合并为：结果就是，共和党候选人在底层的表现至少目前在民调中没有体现出来，而且他们的跌幅远远超过你平时想象的那样。）

sentences.en: So to bring it back to strategy, what you're all saying is that a hugely important part of the Republican strategy here has to be turning out their voters, at least
sentences.zh: 所以回到战略上来，你们所有人都在说，这里共和党战略中一个极其重要的部分必须是动员他们的选民，至少是那些没有背叛他们或总统的选民。

sentences.en: the ones who haven't turned against them or the president.
sentences.zh: 为了回到资金和广告的话题，我想了解共和党人具体是如何通过最后几周的电视广告猛烈攻势来做到这一点的。

sentences.en: And to return to the money and the ads, I want to understand how Republicans are doing that specifically through this onslaught of TV ads in the final weeks.
sentences.zh: 我特别好奇，你们是否看到了这种共和党广告的成功例子，能够做到我们刚才谈论的这一点。

sentences.en: But if you're a Republican pollster or campaign strategist, it is just not acceptable to you that the Democratic candidate for Senate is popular in Texas, Kansas, Iowa, and Alaska,
sentences.zh: 但如果你是共和党民调专家或竞选战略家，你绝对无法接受的是，民主党参议员候选人在德克萨斯州、堪萨斯州、爱荷华州和阿拉斯加州居然很受欢迎，

sentences.en: I mean, yes, but in that case, they are running ads constantly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，是的，但在那种情况下，他们一直在投放广告。

sentences.en: And somebody else is doing that.
sentences.zh: 而且另有人在做这件事。

sentences.en: Somebody else is doing that.

sentences.en: I think the issue is not working yet.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这招现在还不管用。

sentences.en: It's not working yet.
sentences.zh: 现在还不管用。

sentences.en: And I think Nate makes a good point.
sentences.zh: 我觉得内特说得很有道理。

sentences.en: But I also think there's another point, which is that is really hard for these Republicans to distance themselves from President Trump.
sentences.zh: 但我也觉得还有另一点，那就是这些共和党人要与特朗普总统拉开距离真的很难。

sentences.en: They spent most of this congressional session not dissenting from the president in any way, shape or form, basically pushing through his agenda, pushing his few priorities.

sentences.en: And they spent just about a decade at this point really being very cautious about publicly separating themselves from President Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且到了这个时候，他们已经花了大约十年时间，在公开将自己与特朗普总统区分开来这件事上表现得非常谨慎。

sentences.en: But one place where I think you're seeing it really interestingly is in Maine, where Susan Collins, who does have this reputation as this independent Republican,
sentences.zh: 但我认为你看到这种现象非常有意思的一个地方是在缅因州，苏珊·柯林斯在那里确实有着独立共和党人的声誉，

sentences.en: kind of the last of her breed, who, you know, dissents with Trump when she needs to and voted against the tariffs.
sentences.zh: 可以说她是同类人中的最后一位，你知道的，她在必要时会与特朗普意见相左，并且投票反对关税。

sentences.en: Even she in Maine is having a difficult time making that case against a Democratic candidate who comes after a whole bunch of shenanigans that we covered in this show and who isn't all that strong.

sentences.en: So if Susan Collins is struggling to separate herself from Trump,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果苏珊·柯林斯都在艰难地把自己同特朗普剥离，

sentences.en: it really does make you wonder how well and how effectively any other Republican in the country is going to be able to do it.
sentences.zh: 这真的让人不禁怀疑，全国其他任何共和党人未来究竟能把这事做得多好、多有效。

sentences.en: Well, since we're talking about Trump, I want to end the first half of our conversation by talking about his role in this Republican strategy, his personal role in it,
sentences.zh: 好吧，既然我们在谈论特朗普，我想用探讨他在共和党战略中的角色、他在其中的个人角色来结束我们对话的第一部分，

sentences.en: because he's now hitting the campaign trail kind of hard, especially for him in this cycle.
sentences.zh: 因为他现在开始相当猛烈地投入到竞选拉票活动中了，对他在这个选举周期的习惯来说尤其如此。

sentences.en: He's been reluctant to do these events.
sentences.zh: 他以前一直很不情愿参加这些活动。

sentences.en: He's now doing them in the final stretch of the campaign.
sentences.zh: 而现在他正处于竞选的最后冲刺阶段，开始亲力亲为。

sentences.en: Shane, where has he been focusing his time briefly?
sentences.zh: 谢恩，他最近把时间主要集中在哪里了？

sentences.zh: 考虑到他极不受欢迎，他现身到现在为止带来了什么好处？

sentences.zh: 我想你从我们正在讨论的话题中就能看出这种战略，那就是他们需要让共和党人意识到这是一场选举并出来投票。

sentences.en: And so they're sending him to red places.
sentences.zh: 所以他们正把他派往那些红色的地方。

sentences.en: He was in Alaska.
sentences.zh: 他去了阿拉斯加。

sentences.en: That is not typically where you see a presidential rally.

sentences.zh: 而肯·帕克斯顿并不是那种能让每个共和党人都穿上这件战袍的人。

sentences.en: And more specifically, what they're trying to do is engage and turn out like low propensity voters,
sentences.zh: 更具体地说，他们试图做的是吸引并动员那些低意愿选民，

sentences.en: which is our fancy way of saying that people who don't vote very often in midterms and maybe not even presidentials.
sentences.zh: 这是我们的高级说法，意思是在中期选举中不经常投票、甚至在总统大选中可能也不投票的人。

sentences.en: It's what they did successfully in 2024 to build this coalition that elected Trump into office, of course, but it's a lot harder in a midterm.
sentences.zh: 这正是他们在2024年成功做到过的事情，以此建立起将特朗普送入总统宝座的联盟，当然，但在中期选举中这要困难得多。

sentences.en: Their turnout is always lower in midterm elections and it's just a harder goal to set.

sentences.en: I do think we should think about President Trump's role here as an X factor.

sentences.en: They've looked at past special elections and past primaries as test runs for this fall's general election.
sentences.zh: 他们把过去的一些特别选举和初选当作今年秋季大选的压力测试。

sentences.en: Can they put him in a place and blitz people's phones and convince them to vote?

sentences.en: He's been indicted and impeached and so on.
sentences.zh: 他曾被起诉、弹劾等等。

sentences.zh: 但他现在在德克萨斯州选民中的受欢迎程度明显要高于总统。

sentences.en: We need to lower diesel prices.
sentences.zh: 我们需要降低柴油价格。

sentences.en: But I don't think we need to be making a deal with Russia to do it.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们不需要为此与俄罗斯做交易。

sentences.en: I think we should.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们应该这么做。

sentences.en: And, you know, the goal of that policy was to lower prices.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这项政策的目标就是降低价格。

sentences.en: And she stood up and said that she disagrees with that plan.
sentences.zh: 她站出来说她不同意那个计划。

sentences.en: And part of what this reflects is this deep unhappiness with President Trump in rural states like Iowa.
sentences.zh: 这在一定程度上反映了爱荷华州等农业州对特朗普总统的深深不满。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, these farmers and ranchers, I was just in eastern Colorado, and they are just getting killed on everything from diesel prices to the price of hay,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些农民和牧场主——我刚才去了科罗拉多州东部，他们简直快被从柴油价格到干草价格的一切成本压垮了，

sentences.en: I learned is up because it has to be shipped and large.
sentences.zh: 我了解到由于必须大宗运输，干草价格上涨了。

sentences.en: You know, hay is very bulky.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，干草非常占地方。

sentences.en: You have to ship it.
sentences.zh: 你必须运输它。

sentences.en: It takes a lot of diesel to move hay around the country.
sentences.zh: 在全国各地运送干草需要消耗大量的柴油。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If you don't have hay, you can't feed your animals, particularly in the winter if there's snow covering the ground.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有干草，你就无法喂养动物，特别是如果冬天地面积雪覆盖的时候。

sentences.en: So she's under a lot of pressure in Iowa to show independence from the president and particularly on these economic policies and on these costs.
sentences.zh: 所以在爱荷华州，她承受着巨大的压力，要表现出对总统的独立性，特别是在这些经济政策和这些生活成本问题上。

sentences.en: So, you know, we'll see if she's able to give herself that separation.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，我们拭目以待她是否能够让自己保持这种独立距离。

sentences.en: I think Republicans do feel that she's a strong candidate.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党人确实觉得她是一名强有力的候选人。

sentences.en: But I think that little moment in the debate really illustrates that balancing act that a lot of Republican Senate candidates in particular are trying to pull off right now.
sentences.zh: 但我认为辩论中的那个小插曲确实生动地说明了许多共和党参议员候选人目前正在努力维持的那种平衡表演。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we should say that what you're describing was really underscored on Wednesday by news on our homepage here at The Times about new inflation numbers.
sentences.zh: 我们应该说，你所描述的这一点在周三被《时报》首页上关于最新通胀数据的新闻大大强调了。

sentences.en: And gas price alone in the last month was up 34 percent.
sentences.zh: 仅上个月的天然气价格就上涨了34%。

sentences.en: I mean, all the things that normal people are paying attention to as indicators of the economy are bad right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有普通人用来作为经济指标而关注的东西现在都很糟糕。

sentences.en: You have those inflation numbers, you have gas prices, you have interest rates, right?
sentences.zh: 你有那些通胀数据，你有天然气价格，你有利率，对吧？

sentences.en: For all the people who might want to be buying or selling a home are setting new records for recent times.
sentences.zh: 对于所有可能想要买房或卖房的人来说，这些都在创下近期的历史新高。

sentences.en: All of these things that President Trump had promised to tame, they're going in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统曾承诺要驯服的所有这些东西，现在都在朝着错误的方向发展。

sentences.en: And what you see is the White House scrambling to come up with ways to literally send people money ahead of the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 而你看到白宫正忙着想方设法在中期选举前直接给人们发钱。

sentences.en: They've come up with plans to send people money who are on Medicare.
sentences.zh: 他们已经想出了向参加医疗保险的人发钱的计划。

sentences.en: They've come up with a whole different set of proposals to solve this immediate crisis because the day-to-day economic news is bad and keeps getting worse.
sentences.zh: 他们已经提出了一整套完全不同的方案来解决这场迫在眉睫的危机，因为日常的经济新闻很糟糕而且还在不断恶化。

sentences.en: Nate, if it's okay,
sentences.zh: 内特，如果可以的话，

sentences.en: I want to ask you for a debate moment that reflects the Republican strategy to win these Senate races despite all these economic travails that we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我想请你分享一个辩论时刻，它反映了尽管我们正在讨论所有这些经济困境，但共和党赢得这些参议院选举的战略。

sentences.en: So show us your homework.
sentences.zh: 所以向我们展示你的作业吧。

sentences.en: Maybe the most memorable moment from these debates for me was when Susan Collins, Republican senator from Maine,
sentences.zh: 对我和这些辩论最难忘的时刻，也许是缅因州共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯，

sentences.en: attacked Democrat Troy Jackson on not where he's still on the issues, but instead his effectiveness as president of the Maine state senate.
sentences.zh: 抨击民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊不是在议题立场上，而是针对他作为缅因州参议院议长的办事效率。

sentences.en: My opponent, by contrast, struggled to get his bills passed in his 20 years in the legislature.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我的对手在议会工作的20年里，很难让他的法案获得通过。

sentences.en: She alleged that he simply couldn't get things done and couldn't get concrete legislative accomplishments.
sentences.zh: 她指控他根本无法把事情办成，也无法取得具体的立法成就。

sentences.en: He couldn't work with a Democratic governor nor a Republican governor.
sentences.zh: 他既无法与民主党州长合作，也无法与共和党州长合作。

sentences.en: He couldn't get his own Democratic colleagues to co-sponsor and ultimately pass his legislation.
sentences.zh: 他甚至无法让自己的民主党同僚共同提案并最终通过他的立法。

sentences.en: And what it did was it both highlighted Susan Collins' purported or argued strength in this race, which is that she can be an effective lawmaker for Maine.
sentences.zh: 而这所做到的事情，既突显了苏珊·柯林斯在这场竞选中的所谓或争论的优势，那就是她能成为一个对缅因州切实有效的立法者。

sentences.en: That she can bring home pork in the form of appropriations, that she can lobby the president to make exceptions for tariffs, and that Troy Jackson,
sentences.zh: 她能以拨款的形式把实惠带回本土，她能游说总统为关税争取例外，而特洛伊·杰克逊，

sentences.en: while you may agree with him more on the issues, he's not capable of actually getting concrete, practical things done for voters in Maine.
sentences.zh: 虽然你在议题上可能更同意他，但他没有能力真正为缅因州的选民办成具体、务实的事情。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is what you said Republicans need to be doing to win these races.
sentences.zh: 这就是你所说的共和党人为了赢得这些竞选必须做的事情。

sentences.en: They have to knock down their Democratic rivals.
sentences.zh: 他们必须击垮他们的民主党竞争对手。

sentences.en: And you've said several times that Troy Jackson is almost inexplicably poorly performing in the polls.
sentences.zh: 而且你多次说过，特洛伊·杰克逊在民调中的表现几乎令人费解地糟糕。

sentences.en: Yeah, and honestly, I kind of came away from the debate understanding that a little bit better in some way.
sentences.zh: 对，老实说，我看完辩论后，在某种程度上确实对这一点有了更好的理解。

sentences.en: I mean, for starters, I thought that Susan Collins did a good job of highlighting the shortcomings of his record.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，首先，我认为苏珊·柯林斯在揭露他的从政纪录缺点方面做得很好。

sentences.en: And that's been a part of the advertisements that her campaign has been running in Maine over the last few months and also her campaign's allies.
sentences.zh: 这也是她的竞选团队过去几个月在缅因州播放的广告内容的一部分，她的竞选盟友也是如此。

sentences.en: But I also thought that Troy Jackson's performance left something to be desired.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为特洛伊·杰克逊的表现差强人意。

sentences.en: I mean, to take maybe the most juvenile thing I could say, he was on Mike burping during the debate.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，用我能想到的最幼稚的话来说，他在辩论时麦克风没关还打了嗝。

sentences.en: I have proven time and time again that I deliver for the state of Maine.
sentences.zh: 我一次又一次地证明，我为缅因州兑现了诺言。

sentences.en: Now, look, burping is not disqualifying.
sentences.zh: 听着，打嗝并不是取消资格的理由。

sentences.en: I know that you've done it many times on the show, Michael, and they've edited it out, but there are many superficial elements of being an effective candidate,
sentences.zh: 我知道你在节目里打过很多次嗝，迈克尔，他们都给剪掉了，但做一个称职的候选人有很多表面的要素，

sentences.en: and they're hard to talk about.
sentences.zh: 而这些是很难谈论的。

sentences.en: We don't get to ask in a poll question whether you're the kind of person that looks like they're capable of being an effective senator based on the gravitas of their voice or whether they can command the room or whether they look professional.
sentences.zh: 我们不可能在民调中问，根据说话的庄重感、掌控全场的能力或者外表是否专业，你觉得这个人是否有能力成为一个称职的参议员。

sentences.en: Those are hard things to talk about in politics, and I just don't think that Troy Jackson necessarily checks all of those boxes for voters.
sentences.zh: 在政治中这些很难启齿，而且我只是觉得特洛伊·杰克逊未必能满足选民的所有这些标准。

sentences.en: But, I mean, what does it say about the national environment for Republicans that Susan Collins, a very established senator with a strong brand,
sentences.zh: 但是，我的意思是，对于共和党人的全国大环境来说，这说明了什么？苏珊·柯林斯是一位根基深厚、形象极佳的参议员，

sentences.en: voters in the surveys say they like her character, she has a long history of serving her state, and she is not running away with a race against a burper.
sentences.zh: 调查中的选民表示他们喜欢她的品格，她有着长期服务本州的经历，而她在与一个打嗝的人的竞争中却没有遥遥领先。

sentences.en: I think it tells us something, right?
sentences.zh: 我想这说明了一些问题，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Doesn't that tell us something about how difficult the national environment is?
sentences.zh: 难道这不能说明全国政治环境有多艰难吗？

sentences.en: Shane, your debate performance standout moment.
sentences.zh: 谢恩，你认为辩论中表现最突出的时刻是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, I think I would point to the Michigan race where Mike Rogers made a pretty full-throated and aggressive case against Abdul El-Sayed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想我会指出密歇根州的竞选，迈克·罗杰斯当时对阿卜杜勒·埃尔-赛イド发起了一场相当直言不讳且气势汹汹的攻击。

sentences.en: We cannot afford Abdul and we cannot risk his ideology.
sentences.zh: 我们承受不起阿卜杜勒，我们也担不起他那套意识形态的风险。

sentences.en: Think about what he's proposing.
sentences.zh: 想想他提出了什么。

sentences.en: The largest, most massive tax increase in the history, taking over your private health insurance and giving it to the government.
sentences.zh: 史上最大规模、最巨额的增税，接管你的私人医疗保险并把它交由政府支配。

sentences.en: Huge increases in your energy costs.
sentences.zh: 你的能源成本会大幅飙升。

sentences.en: that 30 percent.
sentences.zh: 整整百分之三十。

sentences.en: And one of the lines was that we can't afford your ideology.
sentences.zh: 其中一句话是，我们承受不起你的意识形态。

sentences.en: And it's very clear that Mike Rogers was trying to cast him as outside the mainstream of acceptable candidates
sentences.zh: 很明显，迈克·罗杰斯试图把他打上主流合格候选人之外的标签，

sentences.en: to such an extent that he was floating and raising the possibility of ties of family members to groups.
sentences.zh: 甚至到了抛出并炒作其家庭成员与某些组织存在关联的可能性的地步。

sentences.en: If you have someone in your family that might be on the watch liSt. Are you going to go ahead and say that?
sentences.zh: 如果你家里有人可能上了观察名单，你敢直接说出来吗？

sentences.en: Go ahead and say it.
sentences.zh: 有本事说啊。

sentences.en: No, I'm going to say what?
sentences.zh: 不，我会说什么？

sentences.en: Did you not have family?
sentences.zh: 你难道没有家人吗？

sentences.en: I haven't been tiptoeing around the whole time.
sentences.zh: 我可没有一直在小心翼翼地兜圈子。

sentences.en: Just say it.
sentences.zh: 有本事说出来。

sentences.en: Say it.
sentences.zh: 说啊。

sentences.en: I haven't been tiptoeing it.
sentences.zh: 我可没拐弯抹角。

sentences.en: El-Sayed basically almost accused him of calling him a terroriSt. He stops himself short in that moment.
sentences.zh: 埃尔-赛义德基本上差点指控对方在叫他恐怖分子，他在那一刻硬生生刹住了车。

sentences.en: He said, are you trying to call me a – and he paused like he didn't want to give him that debate clip.
sentences.zh: 他说，你是想叫我——然后他停顿了一下，似乎不想给对方送上这段辩论素材。

sentences.en: And I think all of their exchanges over El-Sayed's record and his positions, it's what feeling you can evoke from voters.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们围绕埃尔-赛义德的从政纪录和立场的每一次交锋，关键都在于你能唤起选民什么样的情绪。

sentences.en: And it's very clear that the Rogers campaign is trying to evoke a feeling of fear that this is a kind of person who you can't trust on a wide spectrum of reasons.
sentences.zh: 很显然，罗杰斯竞选团队正试图唤起一种恐惧感，即这是一个由于种种原因而完全不可信的人。

sentences.en: I'm really glad you used the word fear, Shane, because I do think so far we've been talking about the mainstream advertising, the mainstream messaging,
sentences.zh: 谢恩，我很高兴你用了“恐惧”这个词，因为我的确认为，到目前为止我们一直在讨论主流广告和主流宣传信息，

sentences.en: but I do think we've started to see in the final stretch of this race the kind of unofficial element and form of the Republican strategy,
sentences.zh: 但我也认为我们开始在这场竞选的最后冲刺阶段看到了一种非官方的、形式独特的共和党战略，

sentences.en: and it involves some kind of classic dark arts politicking and some fear mongering.
sentences.zh: 它包含了一些经典的黑暗政治伎俩和贩卖恐惧的行径。

sentences.en: And here I'm thinking specifically about what unfolded in Texas over the past few days.
sentences.zh: 这里我特别想到了过去几天在得克萨斯州发生的事情。

sentences.en: And I wonder which one of the three of you wants to take that on, Lisa.
sentences.zh: 我在想你们三位当中谁想来谈谈这个，丽莎。

sentences.en: So James Tallarico, the Democratic Senate candidate in Texas, was off the trail for more than a week, quite a while in the final stretch of a campaign.
sentences.zh: 得克萨斯州的民主党参议员候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科有超过一周的时间没有公开露面，在竞选的最后冲刺阶段这算是一段相当长的时间了。

sentences.en: His campaign said he had the flu.
sentences.zh: 他的竞选团队称他得了流感。

sentences.en: He has diabetes, so a flu can be more complicated for him.
sentences.zh: 他患有糖尿病，因此流感对他来说可能会更复杂。

sentences.en: The recovery can be longer.
sentences.zh: 康复时间也可能会更长。

sentences.en: And Republicans, largely online, started pushing a theory that he didn't have the flu at all, that he had been checked into a mental health facility, a hospital,
sentences.zh: 而共和党人，主要是在网络上，开始散布一种阴谋论，称他根本没得流感，而是被送进了一家精神健康机构或医院，

sentences.en: and it was in Ohio.
sentences.zh: 而且是在俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: And it was this specific hospital, and they were pushing this narrative that he had some kind of mental health crisis or breakdown, and that's why he was off the trail.
sentences.zh: 甚至还指名道姓是哪家医院，他们大肆宣扬这种说法，称他遭遇了某种心理健康危机或精神崩溃，所以才没有公开露面。

sentences.en: And they pushed this, we should say, in an extremely prolific and coordinated way.
sentences.zh: 必须指出的是，他们以一种极其高产且高度协同的方式在大肆推波助澜。

sentences.en: I believe at one point, someone posted an AI-generated message from this alleged mental institute suggesting that Tallarico was there, he was not.
sentences.zh: 我记得在某个时候，有人发布了一条据称来自这家精神病院的人工智能生成信息，暗示塔拉里科就在那里，而他根本不在。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then finally, the facility in Ohio made a public statement on social media saying he was not here, he's never been here.
sentences.zh: 然后俄亥俄州的那家机构最终在社交媒体上发表公开声明，称他不在、也从未去过这里。

sentences.en: And Tallarico himself said, I'd never been to Ohio at all.
sentences.zh: 塔拉里科本人也表示，他根本就没去过俄亥俄州。

sentences.en: So the thing sort of crashed, although some conservatives online still said they had questions and things like that.
sentences.zh: 所以这件事随后就破产了，尽管网上的一些保守派仍然表示他们有疑问之类的话。

sentences.en: But it was just an illustration.
sentences.zh: 但这只是一个例证。

sentences.en: This was a botched attempt of how Republicans are really going after his character.
sentences.zh: 这是共和党人如何真正对他的品格进行人身攻击的一次拙劣尝试。

sentences.en: They're trying to make him look like he's out of the mainstream.
sentences.zh: 他们试图把他包装成主流之外的人。

sentences.en: There's been not so subtle attacks on his sexuality.
sentences.zh: 对他的性取向的攻击也是司马昭之心路人皆知。

sentences.en: Look, he's straight.
sentences.zh: 听着，他是直男。

sentences.en: He had a big reveal of his girlfriend in the New York Post early in this general election campaign.
sentences.zh: 在这场大选初期的《纽约邮报》上，他曾高调公开过自己的女友。

sentences.en: But the attacks have gone beyond insinuations about his sexuality to Republicans in the highest level of the party really accusing him of sexual perversions.
sentences.zh: 但这些攻击已经超越了对性取向的影射，党内最高层的共和党人甚至直接指控他存在性倒错行为。

sentences.en: I just want to pause you because Vice President Vance within the last day went even further and doubled down on a previous insinuation about James Tallarico.
sentences.zh: 我得打断你一下，因为副总统万斯在过去的一天里变本加厉，对之前关于詹姆斯·塔拉里科的影射进行了双倍加码。

sentences.en: So Vance had, quite a while ago, suggested that, you know, if you were to find James Tallarico's search history online, something would be amiss and untoward.
sentences.zh: 所以万斯在很久以前就暗示过，你知道的，如果你去查詹姆斯·塔拉里科网上的搜索记录，就会发现有些不对劲、见不得光的事情。

sentences.en: He was asked about this as he was going to Texas, and the vice president said, pretty much, I stand by that.
sentences.zh: 当他在前往得克萨斯州途中被问及此事时，副总统基本上表示，我坚持我之前的说法。

sentences.en: And we should just say, there's no evidence of that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须指出，根本没有任何证据支持这一点。

sentences.en: That's some pretty old school, outright character assassination from the vice president of the United States weeks before the election.
sentences.zh: 这是美国副总统在选举前几周使出的那种相当老派、赤裸裸的人格谋杀。

sentences.en: And, you know, one example that really stood out to me is in Kansas, which is a state we haven't talked about specifically yet.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，还有一个让我印象深刻的例子是在堪萨斯州，这是一个我们之前还没有专门讨论过的州。

sentences.en: But it's a, you know, it's a real red state that's now sort of a surprise addition to the map of competitive states.
sentences.zh: 但它是一个真正的红州，现在不知何故成了竞争激烈选形态势图中的一个意外加入者。

sentences.en: And the vice president went after Adam Hamilton, who's the Democratic running there, who is the head of one of the largest churches, not only in Kansas, but in the country,
sentences.zh: 副总统对亚当·汉密尔顿进行了猛烈抨击，他是那里的民主党参选人，不仅是堪萨斯州而且也是全国最大教堂之一的负责人，

sentences.en: and said that he wasn't practicing Christian-y and he called his views left-wing radicalism dressed in the skin suit of our religion, is what Vance said about Hamilton,
sentences.zh: 万斯说汉密尔顿没有践行真正的基督教精神，并称他的观点是“披着我们宗教外衣的左翼激进主义”，这是万斯对汉密尔顿的评价，

sentences.en: who has quite a large flock.
sentences.zh: 而汉密尔顿拥有相当庞大的信众群体。

sentences.en: So these attacks are their character driven, their personal and their desire to cast Democrats as, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以这些攻击是以品格为导向的、针对个人的，其目的在于把民主党人刻画成，你知道的，

sentences.en: really out of the mainstream of everything from Christian faith to just sort of marriage and sexuality.
sentences.zh: 从基督教信仰到婚姻和性取向等各个方面都真正脱离主流的人。

sentences.en: I mean, I think it is actually partly a surround sound message in Texas.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这实际上也是得克萨斯州全方位声音攻势的一部分。

sentences.en: One of the most aired ads in the country this year features a person from the human rights campaign talking about transgender rights and then cutting into James Tallarico and reviving the line from the 2024 campaign is James Tallarico is for they,

sentences.en: them, not you.

sentences.en: that it fits a broad strokes raising questions of why james tallarico has the positions on
sentences.zh: 这符合那种广泛的套路，即对为什么詹姆斯·塔拉里科在过去会持有那些关于

sentences.zh: 我认为关于其有效性的问题之一是，当初究竟是什么让那则针对卡玛拉·哈里斯的广告对共和党人如此奏效，

sentences.en: against Kamala Harris is it spoke to the fact that people didn't feel like she was focused and the Democrats are focused on economic issues that they actually cared most about.
sentences.zh: 是因为它击中了这样一个事实：人们觉得她和民主党人并没有专注于他们真正最关心的经济问题。

sentences.en: And if you listen to the surround sound of what Democrats are talking about this year,
sentences.zh: 如果你听一听今年民主党人铺天盖地都在谈论什么，

sentences.zh: 无论是塔拉里科还是其他人，核心都是经济问题。

sentences.en: And so I think that some of these Republican attacks are going to land differently, even if they're touching the exact same issues they were touching two years ago.
sentences.zh: 因此我认为，其中一些共和党人的攻击将会产生不同的反响，即便他们触及的正是两年前他们触及的那些完全相同的问题。
